name: @wolfigs/weblay
description: Weblay connector — visual in-place editing for any website with one script tag

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts src/editor-entry.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --entry-names=[name] --outdir=dist && mv dist/index.js dist/weblay.js && mv dist/editor-entry.js dist/weblay-editor.js && npm run embed
